claims.claim: London used microwave working very well
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a countertop microwave with control panel and door, but no heating test, no error codes, and no readable brand/model to confirm 'London'.
Photos show a microwave oven, but there is no clear view of grill function indicators, grill rack, or model/specs to confirm microwave+grill capability.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show usage indicators (interior cleanliness, wear, rust, dents) clearly enough to verify 'barely used' or 'no fault'.
Photos cannot confirm whether internal components were opened/serviced.
No documents are shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Not actually working (magnetron/transformer issues) or intermittent faults not visible in photos
risks.proof: A short heating test video: place a cup of water inside, run at high power for a timed interval, show water temperature rising (or thermometer reading) and no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used microwave with unknown working condition (worst case: not guaranteed to heat).

risks.risk: Door seal/hinge not tight; microwave may leak or fail to start reliably
risks.proof: Clip showing the door closing firmly plus a start test (microwave starts normally) and, if possible, a quick check that it does not stop mid-cycle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially having door/closure issues (worst case: unreliable start).

risks.risk: Interior/turntable condition (stains, rust, missing turntable ring/plate) affecting usability
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the interior cavity and the turntable plate/ring laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/dirty interior parts (worst case: turntable components not included).

risks.risk: Grill function may not exist or may be non-functional
risks.proof: Video showing grill mode selection and grill heating (e.g., using the grill rack if present) with no errors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as microwave-only (worst case: grill not working or not supported).

risks.risk: Exact brand/model/wattage unknown; performance and value vary widely
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (rating plate) and any spec sticker on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest spec/most generic case due to unreadable model (worst case: lower wattage).

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents, cracks, damaged door glass) not visible from the single angle
risks.proof: Full 360° photos including door glass close-up and side/back panels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be minor cosmetic/structural damage (worst case: door glass or casing issues).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand/model and rating plate (wattage/serial) on the microwave door frame or inside label.
Short heating test video (cup of water) showing it runs and heats without error codes.
Video showing grill mode (if available) and that it heats properly.
Photos of the interior cavity and the turntable plate/ring to confirm they are present and in good condition.
Photos of the door seal area and a clip of the door closing firmly and starting reliably.
Photos of all sides including door glass close-up and any dents/cracks.
Receipt and warranty card photos (if they truly exist).
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a countertop microwave, but key value drivers (working/heating test, grill capability, exact model/wattage, and included parts) are not verifiable from the provided report. Proof is needed to price confidently.
